boom_down.name: boom down
boom_down.Value: The camera starts high and lowers toward the subject.

sweep.name: sweep
sweep.Value: A wide, horizontal movement across a scene.

reveal.name: reveal
reveal.Value: The jib swings from behind an obstacle to suddenly reveal the subject.

arc.name: arc
arc.Value: The camera keeps the subject in the center of the frame while the background moves behind them.

extreme_close_up.name: extreme close up
extreme_close_up.Value: A shot that isolates a tiny detail of the subject to create high dramatic tension.

close_up.name: close up
close_up.Value: A shot tightly framing a person's face to capture detailed emotional expressions.

medium_close_up.name: medium close up
medium_close_up.Value: A shot framing the subject from the chest/shoulders up to focuses on emotion while keeping the subject grounded.

mid_medium.name: mid medium
mid_medium.Value: A shot framing the subject from the waist up to show both body language and the setting.

cowboy.name: cowboy
cowboy.Value: A medium wide shot captured from the mid-thighs up, focusing on a character’s stance and hip-level action.

full_body.name: full body
full_body.Value: A shot encompassing the subject's entire height to emphasize their movement and physical presence.

wide_shot.name: wide shot
wide_shot.Value: A shot that positions the subject within the environment to show their location and scale.

establishing.name: establishing
establishing.Value: A shot typically used at the start of a scene to provide context for the time and place.

macro.name: macro
macro.Value: A shot of an extremely small object that fills the entire frame to reveal intricate textures.

tilt_shift.name: tilt shift
tilt_shift.Value: A shot using specialized optics to create a shallow depth of field that mimics a miniature look.

split_diopter.name: split diopter
split_diopter.Value: A shot that uses a dual-focus lens to keep two distinct planes of depth in sharp focus at once.

Node_24_mm.name: 24 mm

Node_85_mm.Value: Close-Up Standard. Subject isolation with soft compression.

Node_135_mm.name: 135 mm

octabank.name: octabank
octabank.Value: A soft, eight-sided shape that mimics the roundness of the sun while providing the gentle shadows of a large light source; often considered the "gold standard" for portraits.

clam_shell_arc.name: clam shell arc
clam_shell_arc.Value: A crescent or u-shaped reflection in the bottom of the iris (from a reflector) used to fill in under-eye shadows and make the eye color "pop."

nostalgic.name: nostalgic

neutral_baseline.Value: Relaxed features, mouth closed, eyes forward with no specific emotional weight.

subtle_enigmatic_smile.name: subtle enigmatic smile
subtle_enigmatic_smile.Value: Slight upturn of the corners of the mouth; a "Mona Lisa" look suggesting hidden thoughts.

focused_determination.name: focused determination
focused_determination.Value: Narrowed eyes, slightly furrowed brow, and a tight, set jawline indicating intense concentration.

contemptuous_smirk.name: contemptuous smirk
contemptuous_smirk.Value: One corner of the mouth raised higher than the other, eyes slightly lidded with a judgmental gaze.

vulnerable_melancholy.name: vulnerable melancholy
vulnerable_melancholy.Value: Inner corners of the eyebrows raised and pulled together, slight quiver in the lower lip, glassy eyes.

startled_apprehension.name: startled apprehension
startled_apprehension.Value: Widened eyes with visible sclera, slightly parted lips, and raised eyebrows indicating a sudden shock.

fierce_defiance.name: fierce defiance
fierce_defiance.Value: Flared nostrils, bared teeth or hard-pressed lips, and a piercing, unblinking stare.

weary_resignation.name: weary resignation
weary_resignation.Value: Heavy eyelids, relaxed facial muscles, and a deep exhale captured in the mouth position.

genuine_mirth.name: genuine mirth
genuine_mirth.Value: Wide smile showing teeth, crinkling at the corners of the eyes (Duchenne markers), and high cheeks.

skeptical_scrutiny.name: skeptical scrutiny
skeptical_scrutiny.Value: One eyebrow raised higher than the other, eyes squinted as if examining a detail, mouth slightly pursed.

neutral_stance.name: neutral stance
neutral_stance.Value: Hands by side in a neutral stance.

three_quarter_contrapposto.name: three quarter contrapposto
three_quarter_contrapposto.Value: Weight on one leg, hips angled, creating a natural S curve in the spine.

hand_on_hip.name: hand on hip
hand_on_hip.Value: One hand on the waist, creating a sharp silhouette and projecting confidence.

adjusting_wardrobe.name: adjusting wardrobe
adjusting_wardrobe.Value: Fixing a cufflink, adjusting a collar, or smoothing a skirt for a candid feel.

walking_stride.name: walking stride
walking_stride.Value: Mid-stride, one foot forward, capturing natural motion.

low_hero_crouch.name: low hero crouch
low_hero_crouch.Value: One knee down or a low athletic stance, suggesting readiness or landing.

running_sprint.name: running sprint
running_sprint.Value: Lean forward, arms pumping, capturing high-velocity movement.

leaning_casual.name: leaning casual
leaning_casual.Value: Back against a wall or shoulder against a pillar, one leg crossed.

pensive_seated.name: pensive seated
pensive_seated.Value: Sitting with chin in hand or elbows on knees, looking thoughtful.

guarded_crossed_arms.name: guarded crossed arms
guarded_crossed_arms.Value: Arms folded tightly across the chest, weight shifted to one hip.

triumphant_open.name: triumphant open
triumphant_open.Value: Arms spread wide or raised, chest out, capturing victory or awe.

vulnerable_huddled.name: vulnerable huddled
vulnerable_huddled.Value: Shoulders hunched, arms pulled inward, occupying less space.

deadpan_minimalist.name: deadpan minimalist
deadpan_minimalist.Value: Neutral, low-energy delivery; emotion conveyed through timing rather than physical action.

mumblecore_casual.name: mumblecore casual
mumblecore_casual.Value: Naturalistic, low-stakes movement; frequent small fidgets and unpolished posture.

naturalistic_verite.name: naturalistic verite
naturalistic_verite.Value: Standard cinematic realism; mimics the lack of self-awareness found in documentary subjects.

period_drama_formal.name: period drama formal
period_drama_formal.Value: High postural discipline; restricted, etiquette-driven gestures dictated by social setting.

classical_hollywood.name: classical hollywood
classical_hollywood.Value: Polished and balanced; emphasizes graceful movement, clear eyelines, and heroic symmetry.

method_immersion.name: method immersion
method_immersion.Value: Psychologically heavy; movements are weighted by deep internal subtext and lived-in history.

stylized_noir.name: stylized noir
stylized_noir.Value: High-contrast, deliberate posing; sharp angles and dramatic stillness typical of genre archetypes.

action_heightened.name: action heightened
action_heightened.Value: Kinetic and tactically precise; emphasizes physical prowess and high-velocity responsiveness.

expressionistic_intensity.name: expressionistic intensity
expressionistic_intensity.Value: Exaggerated physicality; external movements are distorted to mirror extreme internal turmoil.

avant_garde_abstract.name: avant garde abstract
avant_garde_abstract.Value: Non-linear physical logic; dreamlike, disjointed, or intentionally uncanny movement patterns.

dissociative_shock.name: dissociative shock
dissociative_shock.Value: Psychological flatline; a blank, staring state where the mind detaches from trauma.

numb_resignation.name: numb resignation
numb_resignation.Value: Passive acceptance; a state of emotional exhaustion where the character ceases to resist.

latent_simmer.name: latent simmer
latent_simmer.Value: Masked intensity; a static exterior successfully containing high internal pressure.

bittersweet_acceptance.name: bittersweet acceptance
bittersweet_acceptance.Value: Layered settling; the quiet, complex coexistence of grief and resolution.

initial_trigger.name: initial trigger
initial_trigger.Value: The catalyst; a specific moment where an external event breaks the character's baseline.

internal_conflict.name: internal conflict
internal_conflict.Value: Emotional tug-of-war; the visible strain of two opposing feelings competing for control.

resilient_recovery.name: resilient recovery
resilient_recovery.Value: Active stabilization; the process of hardening the gaze and physically pulling oneself together.

cascading_escalation.name: cascading escalation
cascading_escalation.Value: Gaining momentum; the phase where emotional "leaks" become impossible to hide.

peak_vulnerability.name: peak vulnerability
peak_vulnerability.Value: Full exposure; the point where all emotional defenses have been stripped away.

explosive_catharsis.name: explosive catharsis
explosive_catharsis.Value: Violent release; a sudden externalization of built-up tension through vocal or physical outbursts.

micro_nod.name: micro nod
micro_nod.Value: Almost imperceptible downward tilt; signals internal agreement or silent submission.

pupillary_shift.name: pupillary shift
pupillary_shift.Value: Momentary darting of the eyes followed by an intense, fixed refocusing on the subject.

digital_fidget.name: digital fidget
digital_fidget.Value: Minute finger movement; a rhythmic tap or picking at a cuticle while the body remains still.

brow_twitch.name: brow twitch
brow_twitch.Value: Involuntary spasm; a quick contraction of the muscles between or above the eyebrows.

masticatory_pulse.name: masticatory pulse
masticatory_pulse.Value: Jaw tension; a rhythmic tightening of the masseter muscle indicating endurance or anger.

lip_compression.name: lip compression
lip_compression.Value: Hard-pressed mouth; a thinning of the lips to hide a tremor or prevent speaking.

swallow_gulp.name: swallow gulp
swallow_gulp.Value: Visible throat movement; a heavy swallow indicating nervousness, fear, or a dry throat.

nasal_dilation.name: nasal dilation
nasal_dilation.Value: Nostril flaring; signals a spike in adrenaline, deep breathing, or suppressed rage.

clavicle_elevation.name: clavicle elevation
clavicle_elevation.Value: Anxious respiration; a slight rising of the shoulders indicating shallow, panicked breathing.

ocular_shimmer.name: ocular shimmer
ocular_shimmer.Value: Glistening eyes; the pre-tear film combined with rapid blinking to manage rising moisture.

stoic_reserved.name: stoic reserved
stoic_reserved.Value: Emotions are internal and tightly controlled; maintains a calm, impassive exterior regardless of pressure.

neurotic_anxious.name: neurotic anxious
neurotic_anxious.Value: Hyper-alert and prone to worry; exhibits nervous energy and over-analyzes potential threats or social cues.

charismatic_extroverted.name: charismatic extroverted
charismatic_extroverted.Value: Magnetic and high-energy; gains confidence from social interaction and naturally seeks to lead or influence others.

cynical_sardonic.name: cynical sardonic
cynical_sardonic.Value: Wary of others' intentions; uses sharp, biting humor as a defense mechanism and views the world through a lens of skepticism.

idealistic_optimistic.name: idealistic optimistic
idealistic_optimistic.Value: Driven by high moral standards and hope; focuses on the potential for good and remains resilient in the face of setbacks.

melancholic_brooding.name: melancholic brooding
melancholic_brooding.Value: Deeply introspective and somber; preoccupied with internal struggles, the past, or the weight of existence.

aggressive_dominant.name: aggressive dominant
aggressive_dominant.Value: Assertive and confrontational; prioritizes control and results, often using intensity to command space and obedience.

submissive_compliant.name: submissive compliant
submissive_compliant.Value: Eager to please and conflict-averse; looks to others for direction and prioritizes harmony over personal agency.

eccentric_unpredictable.name: eccentric unpredictable
eccentric_unpredictable.Value: Highly individualistic with unconventional logic; fluctuates between moods or behaviors in ways that baffle observers.

empathetic_nurturing.name: empathetic nurturing
empathetic_nurturing.Value: Compassionate and highly sensitive to others' emotional states; prioritizes care, support, and the well-being of the group.

Node_070_borderline.Value: Struggles with abstract concepts and complex reasoning; high reliance on environmental cues.

Node_085_low_average.name: 085 low average
Node_085_low_average.Value: Capable of learning through repetition; follows straightforward instructions well.

Node_100_average.Value: Typical cognitive functioning; balanced problem-solving and social awareness.

Node_110_high_average.Value: Quick to catch on; capable of moderate multi-tasking and efficient organization.

Node_120_superior.Value: High capacity for complex thought; articulate and academically proficient.

Node_130_gifted.Value: Rapid information processing; high creative and analytical problem-solving abilities.

Node_145_highly_gifted.Value: Exceptional insight into systems and patterns; easily masters specialized fields.

Node_180_profoundly_gifted.name: 180 profoundly gifted
Node_180_profoundly_gifted.Value: Vastly superior cognitive speed; operates on a level of abstraction incomprehensible to most.

cyclonic_surge.Value: The peak of coastal drama; hurricane-force winds and salt spray that threaten the landscape.

alpine_stillness.Value: Thin, crisp air at high altitude with zero wind; sound travels for miles in the absolute silence.

mountain_draft.Value: Cool, sharp gusts that whistle through rock faces, signaling a drop in pressure and rising altitude.

jungle_steam.name: jungle steam
jungle_steam.Value: Heavy, static humidity where the air feels like a physical weight; clouds hang low and unmoving.

monsoon_buildup.Value: Deep purple clouds gathering over the canopy; the air becomes electric and the wildlife goes silent.

tropical_deluge.name: tropical deluge

soft_bloom.name: soft bloom
soft_bloom.Value: A dreamlike glow where highlights bleed into shadows, softening every edge.

crisp_clarity.name: crisp clarity
crisp_clarity.Value: Ultra-transparent air with high contrast and razor-sharp definition on distant objects.

suspended_dust.name: suspended dust
suspended_dust.Value: Fine particles caught in shafts of light, creating a sense of age and stillness.

ground_mist.name: ground mist
ground_mist.Value: A thin, low-lying vapor that clings to the floor, muffling sound and obscuring the base of objects.

heat_haze.name: heat haze
heat_haze.Value: Visible ripples of refracted light rising from the surface, distorting the background in rhythmic waves.

heavy_smog.name: heavy smog
heavy_smog.Value: A dense, yellowish veil of urban pollutants that chokes the light and tastes of metal.

oppressive_fog.name: oppressive fog
oppressive_fog.Value: A thick, white wall of moisture that reduces visibility to a few meters and feels claustrophobic.

electric_tension.name: electric tension
electric_tension.Value: A charged, ozone-scented atmosphere that makes hair stand on end before a massive lightning discharge.

volcanic_ash_fallout.name: volcanic ash fallout
volcanic_ash_fallout.Value: Heavy, gray particles drifting through the air, coating everything in a layer of abrasive grit.

bioluminescent_glow.name: bioluminescent glow
bioluminescent_glow.Value: A magical, faint radiance permeating the air, caused by microscopic floating spores or gasses.

slick_lichen.name: slick lichen

eroding_bluff.name: eroding bluff
eroding_bluff.Value: Coastal terrain actively collapsing under the force of water and wind; a state of total instability.

polished_shale.name: polished shale
polished_shale.Value: High-altitude rock surfaces, dry and slick from wind erosion, offering little traction.

wind_swept_scree.name: wind swept scree
wind_swept_scree.Value: Loose mountain stones and gravel constantly shifted by high-altitude gusts.

frozen_permafrost.name: frozen permafrost
frozen_permafrost.Value: Hardened ice and rock at the mountain peak; a lethal, unyielding surface that reflects blue light.

baked_clay.name: baked clay
baked_clay.Value: Hard-packed earth at the jungle's edge, cracked from heat but still structurally solid.

damp_leaf_litter.name: damp leaf litter
damp_leaf_litter.Value: A thick, springy layer of decaying jungle vegetation that remains perpetually moist and soft.
